name: Thomas Wozny
current_position: Spine neurosurgery fellow, University of Miami (from 2025)
evidence: Archived Pitt current-residents page (Nov 18 2018) lists Thomas Wozny under PGY-1. Archived UCSF residents page Oct 2018 does NOT list him (UCSF PGY-1 that year included Claire Faltermeier, who left for cardiothoracic surgery); UCSF residents pages list Wozny as PGY-2 in 2019-20, PGY-3 2020-21 ... PGY-7 2024-25 (project roster intake, rosters_program76.json / rosters_program116.json; web.archive.org was not fetchable in this session, so these are from the project's earlier captures). UCSF 2025 graduates article: Pitt BS+MD, 'completed a seven-year neurosurgery residency training program at UCSF', finishing June 21 2025, next spine fellowship at University of Miami. UCSF alumni list: Thomas Wozny, 2025, Spine Fellowship, University of Miami. Pitt PSTP page: Pitt MD 2018, residency Neurological Surgery UCSF.
notes: Conflict resolved: both sources are right. He was a Pitt neurosurgery PGY-1 in 2018-19 and moved to UCSF as a PGY-2 in July 2019, filling the spot left by Faltermeier. The UCSF article's 'seven-year residency' counts the whole program length, including his Pitt intern year, and does not mean all 7 years were at UCSF. This agrees with current_outcome 'LEFT -> TRANSFERRED (UCSF)' and corrects batch_9's 'conflicting'/'never at Pitt' guess. Completed neurosurgery elsewhere (UCSF 2025).
